title: The Killer Reserved Nine Seats
writer: Biagio Proietti, Paolo Levi, Giuseppe Bennati
actors: Rosanna Schiaffino, Chris Avram, Eva Czemerys
plot: Patrick Davenant invites a group of friends and his daughter to his family-owned theater. Within a short time, the guests realize that they are trapped. A masked killer begins to murder them one by one.
